claims.text: The as-cast AlCoCrFeNi2.1 eutectic HEA is ductile and has a ductile FCC matrix within a B2/FCC multiphase structure.
The as-cast FCC matrix is a random solid solution with minimal long-range order.
Aging AlCoCrFeNi2.1 produces a ductile-brittle-ductile sequence, with minimum elongation near 600°C and recovered ductility near 750°C.
The transition is driven by non-monotonic APBE and SISFE evolution in the FCC matrix.
An FCC-matrix high-entropy superalloy containing L12 ordered precipitates can be strengthened by low matrix stacking-fault energy and high precipitate APBE.
At about 600°C, Ni3Al-like L12 domains in AlCoCrFeNi2.1 become near-stoichiometric and attain maximal ordering.
Near-stoichiometric L12 ordering at 600°C maximizes the APBE.
High APBE restricts cross-slip and forces dislocations into planar slip bands.
Aging near 600°C forms sharp, jagged or serrated B2/FCC phase boundaries.
Jagged B2/FCC boundary serrations act as stress concentrators.
Planar slip bands interacting with jagged interfaces cause premature crack initiation and brittle failure at 600°C.
At 750°C, the L12 long-range order parameter decreases, lowering APBE and restoring cross-slip.
At 750°C, B2/FCC interfaces become smoother or coarser, or develop ductile transition zones that relieve stress concentration.
The L12 ordering parameter is approximately 0.8-0.9 at 600°C and falls below 0.6 at 750°C.
The brittle transition occurs when the L12 ordering parameter exceeds an approximately 0.8 critical threshold and interface roughness also exceeds a critical value.
The critical high-order and jagged-interface condition is typically observed between 550°C and 650°C.
The 600°C state will exhibit higher hardness and a lower indentation size effect than the 750°C state.
HEAs can decompose into multiple phases when composition or annealing temperature is changed.
Simple phase decomposition would imply a continuous loss of strength rather than a localized brittle window.
Smoothing the interface at 600°C while holding the ordering parameter fixed should restore ductility if interface jaggedness is causal.
